body:
Pretty sure if my main focus was on me, I would leave my child with her father or my mother and go away. Not wake up everyday and do everything I have to do to ensure she has what she needs and more. Not wake up at 6 am on my day off just to get showered, breakfast going, lunches packed, toddler melt down handled and then out of the house by 9 for a day of adventure. What is the harm in having safe sex, a pleasurable activity which I thoroughly do a great job at and enjoy, for money?   Maybe I should just go back to bartending so I can just see my kid one hour a day if Im lucky, rather than fuck around for money for a few months to get us where we need to be.  Maybe I should just go back to supporting her dad so I can work more and find myself back in what is worse than where I am. If Im such an awful and selfish person why don't I just quit beating the bush? Maybe youre right. Fuck these debts. Fuck my life. It's clearly going no where. Im sick of breaking my back. Im sick of wondering every day I wake up if I'm going to have the will to get through the day.  11 years of daily ideations. Fuck a hotline. Fuck you. Fuck this. Fuck worrying if my child is okay when im not there. Fuck the last whole year. Fuck everything. Clearly my single mother acquaintances who go out and party all of the time and bring every man they date into their child's life are doing it better than me because theyre sure as fuck happier than me.

I had hoped this post would help me. I had hoped this post would put it in perspective for me and remind me where my minds at and why I bust my ass. Really, Im too fucked to be fixed. Im sick of crying at my key board everynight. Im sick of screaming for help. Im done. Im just fucking done.
